status: locally frozen before formal measurement; not externally preregistered
question: M2: does exact incremental heap ordering change the execution boundary relative to full sort and both partial-top-k materializers?
heap: Score every rankable vertex exactly once; std::make_heap with greater<pair<double,int>> builds a min-heap. Pop the exact next (squared-distance,identifier) key, share reverse memoized proofs, stop at k positives or heap exhaustion. No eligible count/set/certificate is exposed to execution.

main.additional: one h4,k10 explicit-empty origin query per graph; other queries Gaussian; unchanged historical generator

matched.query: same graph, vector query and predicate across k per seed; historical chosen cell remains exploratory

dimension.pairing: topology reset after corpus-vector generation; two query conditions interleaved in randomized per-graph order

real.dataset: persisted FB15k-237 inverse-augmented training graph and lexical SVD128 vectors; same fixed 80 queries

timing.host: local Ubuntu WSL, CPU4 virtual affinity
timing.timer: one outer steady_clock interval; no per-distance/subphase timers
included: fresh proof arrays and score/order storage
timing.randomization: fixed mt19937 seeds shuffle graph groups, query configurations within graph, and all four methods within each warmup/repetition; all four methods are remeasured together
timing.limitations: virtual affinity does not guarantee exclusive physical core or fixed clock frequency; do not pool new absolute times with historical cohorts

verification.oracle: independent flat-edge relation scan for eligible set; same scalar double numeric contract and identifier tie rule
verification.every_execution: each warmup and measured result must equal exact oracle answer; each repetition/warmup must have identical full-sort/heap answer and root-sequence digest, root count, edges, states, distances and pauses; heap pops equal root checks
verification.tests: 20736 exact plan comparisons,1296 complete heap/full-sort order checks, including dense all-zero ties, cycles, empty and underfilled answers and quantum1/2/7/256
verification.fingerprints: FNV64 for graph/vector/query/eligible/answer identity, SHA256 for file integrity

analysis.aggregation: median of three repetitions per configuration; retain individual rows and all losses
analysis.winner_tables: four-way winners and repeated historical three-way winners within this NEW batch; selectivity bins 0,(0,.01),[.01,.1),[.1,.5),[.5,.9),[.9,.9998),[.9998,1]
analysis.matched_k: paired median ratio to faster materializer, full-sort/heap paired ratios, wins; 10000 paired seed-cluster bootstrap samples, seed20261028
analysis.dimension: report each origin/Gaussian,d stratum: wins/40, paired median and IQR plus ratio of mean query medians, and dense h6 subgroup
analysis.dependencies: main600 design predicate slots,573 distinct structural predicates; k values share predicates, sparse empty predicates repeat across seeds; degree480 design predicates and historical overlaps; dimension40 structural graph/predicate units reused across dimensions/conditions; no broad population claims
analysis.real: all80 and49 without an immediately adjacent inverse relation pair; do not construct new query subsets from winners
analysis.diagnostic_model: heap ordering work O(N+r log N) is analytic, timings must be measured; no online decision-rule claim

pilot: 20 configurations/240 timings used only for debugging and runtime estimation, excluded from all formal summaries
